name: 0000-MAIN
description: The paragraph initializes the program's execution by opening necessary resources, performing a main loop, and then closing resources before returning control.

algorithm.details: Opens files or other I/O resources required at the start of the process.
Transfers control to a looping construct for performing main program actions.
Closes any opened files or resources after processing is complete.
Ends program execution and returns control to the operating environment or caller.

sideEffects.description: Potential file or resource access and modifications during the process.
